_comment: OMAKASE publishes the answer outright, in the 予約ルール詳細 panel: 次回枠の受付開始日時.
It is state, not a rule — it changes every month, and the time of day differs per shop
(08:00 / 13:00 / 15:00 / 23:00 among these five), so nothing can compute it. 蒼 says 未定,
which is the platform declining to predict its own next window.
These rows were transcribed by hand from screenshots on 2026-07-28 because this
environment is Cloudflare-blocked from omakase.in. poll-omakase.mjs replaces them with
fresh readings; until it has run, this is the seed. `observedAt` is what makes a stale
reading visible instead of silently wrong.
Times are JST (+09:00). Japan has no DST, so the offset is exact year-round.

_comment: A lottery, not a queue. The deadline that matters closes BEFORE the release:
miss the application window and you cannot take part at all, however fast you are
on the day. Dates below are the page's own worked example for a 1st-of-month
release, which matches this shop's stated 次回枠 of 2026-08-01 13:00.
The general rule: 予約開始月1日の8日前より応募が開始.
